title: Amaanaa Lagaaf Imaanaa Kenname
intro: Lubbuun tokko labsii hin danda’amne, kan jireenyi daa’ima reefuu dhalatee madaallii irratti fannifame, isa mudate. Hafuura waaqaatiin qajeelfamee ajajni abdii kutannaa tokko ni ajajame, iccitiin gatii guddaa qabu tokkos kaarentii irratti kan kaa’ame yoo ta’u, karaa hin eegamneen deebi’e.
clues: Gaaddidduu abbaa irree dhiira reefuu dhalate akka ajjeefamuu ajaju jala jiraadhe.
Hafuura waaqummaa natti dhufe, tarkaanfii abdii kutannaa fi garaa namaa cabsu akkan fudhadhu na qajeelche.
Daa’ima koo qaaliin garaa keessa kaa’ee laga yaa’aa jiru irra kaa’e.
Onneen koo duwwaa taate, iccitiis ifa baasuuf jedhe, garuu Rabbiin murtoo koo na jabeesse.
Kaarentiin garaa sana baatee waan deemuuf imala daa'imaa gara gadiitti hordofuuf nama erge.
Mucaan kun mana abbaa irree sanaan kan argame yoo ta’u, dhumarratti, mucaa koo waliin deebi’ee walitti makamee hojjettuu kunuunsaa ta’e.

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Mucaa ishee garaa keessa kaa'attee laga irra kaa'atte
Mucaa ishee gammoojjii keessatti gattee deemte
Mucaa ishee balbala masjiida tokkootti dhiistee deemte
trial.answer: Mucaa ishee garaa keessa kaa'attee laga irra kaa'atte

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Mucaa ishee waliin deebitee wal argamtee hoosiste
Kana booda mucaa ishee argitee hin beektu
Lafa biraatti godaantee baqattummaa keessa jiraatte
outcome.answer: Mucaa ishee waliin deebitee wal argamtee hoosiste

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
